headline: Nakoda Group of Industries reports September quarter financial results
summary: Nakoda Group of Industries Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance data for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can review these figures on the exchange portal to assess the company's recent operational health and earnings trajectory.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for review

headline: Nakoda Group of Industries receives SEBI demat-only compliance certificate
hook: Nakoda Group achieves mandatory demat compliance
summary: Nakoda Group of Industries has secured a compliance certificate from SEBI regarding its shareholding structure. The company has transitioned to a demat-only format for its shareholdings as per regulatory requirements. This move ensures the company aligns with current market standards for electronic share maintenance. Retail investors holding physical shares should ensure their holdings are converted to demat form to maintain liquidity and trading eligibility.
why_it_matters: Ensures your shares remain tradable and compliant with SEBI norms.
